operations.title: Pairing-preserving radical repairs form a Hom-complex torsor
operations.statement: If one radical-valued repair C0 exists, all repairs are C0+Z for Z in Z^0(Hom(C(G),R)); modulo radical chain homotopy they form a torsor under H^0(Hom(C(G),R)).

operations.title: One-term radical complex exposes repair nonuniqueness
operations.procedure: Take source and radical equal to Z in degree zero, with zero differentials and zero defect.
operations.outcome: Every integer multiplication is a distinct repair and no nontrivial homotopies identify them.
operations.falsifier: This falsifies uniqueness of a repair from obstruction vanishing alone.
